name: Dhampir
source:
End of 20th century. Bar "Ayakashi" in an ambiguous town actually serves as undercover base for monster exterminators. Main character gets a job here and drowns into the life of forbidden love and vile monsters.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-august-2001-kimi-ga-nozomu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
20世纪末，一座暧昧难明的城市里，酒吧“妖异”实际上是退魔人的秘密据点。主人公在此谋得一份工作，自此深陷于禁忌爱恋与邪恶妖魔交织的生活。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-august-2001-kimi-ga-nozomu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
